_comment: CAPABILITY OBSERVATIONS, the original; Redis holds a copy (scripts/roster_capability.py). An observation says what was SEEN of one roster instance on one resource. It is not a grant and not a denial. can is yes, no or unknown. status is verified, reported or unknown, and basis says why: verified means EXECUTED, that runtime did the thing and it was observed; what an access list says (acl) and what somebody says (stated) are only reported; unknown has basis none and means nobody looked. checked_at is when somebody last looked; older than a day reads as STALE. Change this file only by a reviewed commit that names the event which is the evidence.
